command:
import os, json, psycopg

dsn = os.environ.get('APP_DB_URL', '').strip()
assert dsn, 'APP_DB_URL missing'
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('''
SELECT "Screening_Type", "Search_Definition_ID", search_definition_name, is_active, display_order
FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings
WHERE "Screening_Type" IN ('SAN-PGHK','SAN-PFIC','SAN-PGJP')
ORDER BY display_order
''')
rows=[{'Screening_Type':r[0],'Search_Definition_ID':r[1],'search_definition_name':r[2],'is_active':r[3],'display_order':r[4]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
print('MAPPING_CHECK', json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False))
cur.close(); conn.close()
